{{Top|leg}}
The '''Pheromone package''' enabled the user to subtly secrete synthetic pheromones that generally prompted a pleasant behavior response in a wide range of species, thus the user was looked upon with more favor.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, the playable character must have a constitution attribute of 12 or higher.
